source: PFF+ Premium Stats CSV export (2025 REG), official download

roster.note: 2025 grades, counted for each player's current 2026 club (team_2025 shown on movers). Free agents, retired players and practice-squad players are left out; IR players stay in (debited through the injury sheet).

scoring.note: Same 22 per club (11 OFF + 11 DEF by 2025 PFF grade, min snaps, on the 2026 roster). Surplus vs league mean of those 22. 5 grade ≈ 1 point, cap ±1.5. Does not rewrite the 2025 prior. Raw CSVs stay off the public desk.
